interview.hardest_part: Interpreting pixel-art screenshots to accurately recognize objects, NPCs, and UI elements in a 2D game with artistic variations
interview.likely_failure: Misclicking or incorrect timing in menus, dialogue, or tool use due to vision errors or imprecise mouse control
interview.helpful_mechanics: WASD movement, C/X interactions, and grid-based farming/fishing that reward repetition and simple progressions
interview.harmful_mechanics: Random events, seasonal changes, and the need for precise in-game time management across multiple overlapping systems
